features.title: AgentBinder — identify agent kind from initialCommand / title / OSC 9 banner
features.verification_posture: build-only — unit tests committed but exec deferred to touch-codeTests cleanup plan; OSC 133 prompt-end dispatch dormant pending libghostty OQ-1
features.preconditions: T1 + T2 committed. RootFeature has the existing engineEventReceived chain that already routes paneInfoChanged / paneExited etc. SurfaceInfo exposes title and lastNotificationTitle; libghostty may or may not deliver paneInfoChanged(.promptEnd) — OQ-1 tracks that.
features.expected_behavior: A new @MainActor AgentBinder is wired up at AppState.bringUp. verification_steps: make mac-test ARGS="-only-testing:touch-codeTests/AgentBinderTests" passes — covers initialCommand match, title-only match, sticky behaviour without prompt-end, rebind on prompt-end, paneExited unbind, no-match silence.
